lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhulaane s manamukh kaheeahi naa uravaar na paare ||3||
lines.translation: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan paae gur kaa sabad samhaale ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan maaiaa maahi nisataare ||
lines.translation: In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag hovai jis masatak kaalahi maar bidaare ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: atul kiu toliaa jaai ||
lines.translation: How can the unweighable be weighed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa hoi ta sojhee paai ||
lines.translation: If there is anyone else as great, then he alone could understand the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis te doojaa naahee koi ||
lines.translation: There is no other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਕੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis dee keemat kikoo hoi ||1||
lines.translation: How can His value be estimated? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa ko jaanai dubidhaa jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One comes to know Him, when duality departs. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap saraaph kasavatee laae ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Assayer, applying the touch-stone to test it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape parakhe aap chalaae ||
lines.translation: He Himself analyzes the coin, and He Himself approves it as currency.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape tole pooraa hoi ||
lines.translation: He Himself weights it perfectly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape jaanai eko soi ||2||
lines.translation: He alone knows; He is the One and Only Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaa roop sabh tis te hoi ||
lines.translation: All the forms of Maya emanate from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no mele s niramal hoi ||
lines.translation: He alone becomes pure and immaculate, who is united with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no laae lagai tis aai ||
lines.translation: He alone is attached, whom the Lord attaches.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sach dikhaale taa sach samaai ||3||
lines.translation: All Truth is revealed to him, and then, he merges in the True Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape liv dhaat hai aape ||
lines.translation: He Himself leads the mortals to focus on Him, and He Himself causes them to chase after Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap bujhaae aape jaape ||
lines.translation: He Himself imparts understanding, and He reveals Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape satigur sabad hai aape ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aakh sunaae aape ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He Himself speaks and teaches. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib te sevak sev saahib te kiaa ko kahai bahaanaa ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has made me His servant, and blessed me with His service; how can anyone argue about this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa ik teraa khel baniaa hai sabh mahi ek samaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Such is Your play, One and Only Lord; You are the One, contained among all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur parachai har naam samaanaa ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is pleased and appeased, one is absorbed in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis karam hovai so satigur paae anadin laagai sahaj dhiaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy, finds the True Guru; night and day, he automatically remains focused on the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa koee teree sevaa kare kiaa ko kare abhimaanaa ||
lines.translation: How can I serve You? How can I be proud of this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਖਿੰਚਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਖਾ ਵਖਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jab apunee jot khi(n)chahi too suaamee tab koee karau dikhaa vakhiaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: When You withdraw Your Light, O Lord and Master, then who can speak and teach? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape gunee nidhaanaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the humble disciple; You Yourself are the treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu aap chalaae tivai koee chaalai jiu har bhaavai bhagavaanaa ||3||
lines.translation: As You cause us to move, so do we move, according to the Pleasure of Your Will, O Lord God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak too saachaa saahib kaun jaanai tere kaamaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, You are the True Lord and Master; who can know Your actions?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa ghar mahi de vadiaaee ik bharam bhavahi abhimaanaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: Some are blessed with glory in their own homes, while others wander in doubt and pride. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa thaat banaaiaa poorai vekhahu ek samaanaa ||
lines.translation: The perfect Lord has fashioned the Perfect Creation. Behold the Lord pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: is parapa(n)ch mahi saache naam kee vadiaaee mat ko dharahu gumaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: In this play of the world, is the glorious greatness of the True Name. No one should take pride in himself. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee jis no mat aavai so satigur maahi samaanaa ||
lines.translation: One who accepts the wisdom of the True Guru's Teachings, is absorbed into the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih baanee jo jeeahu jaanai tis a(n)tar ravai har naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name abides deep within the nucleus of one who realizes the Bani of the Guru's Word within his soul. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਨਰ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu jugaa kaa hun nibeRaa nar manukhaa no ek nidhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Now, this is the essence of the teachings of the four ages: for the human race, the Name of the One Lord is the greatest treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਓਨਾ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jat sa(n)jam teerath onaa jugaa kaa dharam hai kal mahi keerat har naamaa ||2||
lines.translation: Celibacy, self-discipline and pilgrimages were the essence of Dharma in those past ages; but in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Praise of the Lord's Name is the essence of Dharma. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug aapo aapanaa dharam hai sodh dekhahu bed puraanaa ||
lines.translation: Each and every age has its own essence of Dharma; study the Vedas and the Puraanas, and see this as true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jinee dhiaaiaa har har jag te poore paravaanaa ||3||
lines.translation: They are Gurmukh, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; in this world, they are perfect and approved. ||3||
